description.content: Adds a dedicated Claude provider type with an Anthropic Messages form, a per-model adaptive thinking switch, thinking budgets for budget-driven models, and paginated Anthropic model discovery that fills recorded capacities for known Claude models.
新增专用的 Claude 提供商类型，提供 Anthropic Messages 表单、逐模型自适应思考开关、预算思考模型的思考 token 预算，以及分页的 Anthropic 模型探测，并为已知 Claude 模型预填录制的容量参数。
